title: SISA: A Scale-In Systolic Array for GEMM Acceleration
selection_reason: SISA is a scale-in systolic array redesign that handles the skewed, input-dependent GEMM shapes produced by LLM workloads, raising processing-element utilization over square arrays; a direct accelerator contribution for LLM execution, hence accept.
